Technical Workshop

Revit Architecture

Date

15th March

Duration

5 Hours

Register Now

Venue: IIT Bombay Campus

Mode: Offline

Workshop starts 11:00 AM onwards

Master BIM Technology

Revit is a powerful BIM software, revolutionizing building design with intelligent 3D models. Crucial for architects and engineers, it sets new benchmarks in efficiency and innovation throughout the project lifecycle.

Prerequisites:
  • Laptops are mandatory for hands-on sessions.
  • Foundational knowledge in building design or drafting is recommended.
  • Should have revit software installed well before the workshop.

Why Join Us?

Certification

Autodesk Workshop Certificate for all participants.

Hands-on

Work with parametric 3D design tools directly.

Career Edge

Enhance employability with industry-standard BIM skills.

Professional Development

Gain insights from experts in construction management.

Workshop Timeline

  • Fill out the Google Form to register for the workshop.
  • Carefully follow and complete the installation and setup guidelines shared with you to install Autodesk Revit before the workshop.
  • Come to IIT Bombay with your laptop and the installed Revit setup, and enjoy the hands-on learning session with Autodesk experts.
